🧮 MathChallenge

Math Challenge pits you against a series of arithmetic problems with a countdown timer. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Read the math problem and calculate the answer.
  2. Type or click your answer before the timer runs out.
  3. Faster answers earn more points.
  4. Mix of operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division.
  5. Your score is the number of correct answers within the time limit.
